newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel June industrial output up annual 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel June industrial output up annual 5.4 pct.

text.p: Israel's industrial output in June rose, the Central Bureau of Statistics said.
In all of 1995 industrial output rose 8.4 percent.
The statistics bureau said the trend in May and June indicated an annual rise of four to five percent, the same level as in previous months.

The increase in output until May was particularly high in heavy industries (metals, machinery and transport equipment), which rose by an annualised nine percent, as well as in the electronics and plastics sectors, which increased six percent.
The food and building products sectors reported almost no change while production shrank in the textile, clothing, leather, paper and print sectors.
Industrial exports rose at an annual rate of six to seven percent from May to July following stable levels in the February-April period.
